Magnolia Sky

About Magnolia Sky

Introducing Magnolia Sky — a feel-good festival-style live band bringing the perfect blend of pop + folky anthems to weddings and events. Inspired by the big, stomp-and-clap energy of Mumford &amp; Sons and the warmth of modern acoustic singer-songwriter pop , this band delivers a relaxed, uplifting atmosphere… and then (before you know it) has everyone singing, clapping, and dancing . Available as a 3-piece or 4-piece , Magnolia Sky features lead vocals + acoustic guitar , bass , drums , and the unmistakable sparkle of banjo/mandolin/fiddle with rich backing vocals . They’ve been dazzling audiences since 2014 , and that experience shows in every detail — from pacing the night perfectly to reading the room and lifting the energy exactly when it matters. At the heart of the band is Brendan — an exceptional frontman with a signature tone, studied songwriting at BIMM , signed by BMG , and racking up 5M+ Spotify streams . He’s the kind of performer who makes every song feel personal, every chorus feel massive, and every guest feel part of the moment. Backed by a seriously accomplished lineup (including multi-instrumentalist Tom , because apparently one instrument simply isn’t enough), Magnolia Sky blends musicianship and charisma in a way that feels effortless, warm, and totally unforgettable. With a 100-song repertoire , you can tailor your setlist (up to 32 picks ), request a special song (perfect for a first dance ), and enjoy DJ-style playlists , optional bandmember DJing , plus full PA &amp; lighting — so you can tick entertainment off your list in one swoop.
